name: WPC Product QR Code
author: WPClever

sections.description:
WPC Product QR Code is a powerful yet easy-to-use tool for WooCommerce stores to bridge the gap between physical and digital shopping experiences. By automatically generating QR codes for every product, you can enhance marketing efforts, improve customer engagement, and streamline product access from mobile devices.

The plugin uses a smart short URL redirect system, ensuring that QR codes remain simple and easy to scan even for long product permalinks.

Key Features

  • Automatic Generation: Every product gets a unique QR code automatically.
  • Branding Support: Add your own logo to the center of the QR code.
  • Short URL System: Uses the /qr/{code} format for more reliable scanning.
  • Easy Access: A “QR Code” button is added to the single product page for customers.
  • Interactive Popup: Displays the QR code in a clean modal window.
  • Text Customization: Add custom text above or below the QR code.

Detailed Customization

You can customize the QR code appearance to match your brand:
* Select Solid or Gradient colors.
* Choose between Linear and Radial gradient types.
* Pick different styles for corner dots.
* Adjust Top and Bottom text with a {link} placeholder for the product URL.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/wpc-product-qr-code directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to WooCommerce -> Product QR Code to configure the settings.
  4. The QR Code button will automatically appear on your product pages.
